name: Fujisaki Asahi
source:
Fujisaki Asahi is a 3rd year student in Suzumori Gakuen, making her [url=/c500]Shuuji’s[/url] senpai. She’s a loli appearance-wise, and also does things on her own pace. As the head of the drama club, Asahi tried getting Shuuji to join ever since their first meeting. Shuuji’s classmate [url=/c504]Nanami Mina[/url] loves Asahi so much, up to the point where she thinks Asahi is hers alone.

[Edited from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2010/02/06/asukimi-fujisaki-asahi/]Rin's character review[/url].]
